beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: A few days later, contract still unsigned, Riley wants to see the whole shape of it before she answers.

beats.prompt: The past: the leap that put you on this tour with nothing but the songs and nerve.
The present: the partnership you chose, and the choice that's still shaping how you work.
The future: the space you're about to claim, whether the label likes it or not.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Okay, quiz me. If the Emperor's about acting without hesitation, doesn't the fact that I've been sitting on this contract for four days mean I already blew it?"

options.text: No — it's about acting decisively when the moment actually calls for it, not being instant about everything.
Yes, hesitating at all means you failed the card.
The Emperor doesn't care about timing either way.

elaboration: Ready to act the instant it counts doesn't mean rushing every decision — it means not flinching once you actually know what you want.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "And if I tell them no, co-writer or not, doesn't that just make me the difficult one again?"

options.text: Setting clear boundaries and claiming space isn't difficult — it's just refusing to apologize for it.
Yes, saying no always makes you difficult.
Boundaries aren't part of this card.

elaboration: Sets clear boundaries and claims space without apology — that's not a flaw the card is warning you about, it's the actual message.

beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: "One thread ties all three: the leap that got you here, the partnership you're still weighing, and the shape you're finally ready to give this yourself."

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Yeah. I think I've been treating 'claiming space' like it needed someone else's permission first. It doesn't. Thanks — that actually helps."
